C-58.IntentSummary: Ship the approved diagram-gallery prototype as the site's /diagrams/ page: build-time Pele SVGs from a shared examples corpus, theme variables derived from the app's own theme files and buildPeleVariables, theme strip + slideshow + fullscreen show, site integration (brand, head, nav, landing link, sitemap), one honest type count across all materials, and site checks.

Corner.Situation: Visitor in OS dark mode, first visit
Corner.Expected: Ink selected, page chrome dark, marker headline readable

Corner.Situation: Theme switch during Slideshow / Fullscreen show
Corner.Expected: any chip click or Esc stops the timer; no two timers ever run
only the filtered cards are shown; counter reads N of the filtered set
one column, strip scrolls horizontally inside itself, no page h-scroll, show fits the safe area

Corner.Situation: A theme file is added to the app
Corner.Expected: next site build includes it automatically; the vars test count follows the theme directory

Corner.Situation: An example stops parsing after a pele upgrade
Corner.Expected: the gallery unit test and site check fail the build (no silent error card)

T-001.Title: Corpus + theme vars: site/gallery/examples.mjs (port the prototype's 32 examples), gallery-theme-vars.mjs deriving theme-vars.json from the app theme CSS via buildPeleVariables, parity + render tests

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Every example renders with pele 1.6.0; 32 themes × 16 keys; Paper/Ink match the 2026-10-18 runtime snapshot.

T-002.Title: Page build: build-gallery.mjs (template, cards, controller script for strip/slideshow/fullscreen/filters/copy), emitted at /diagrams/ in buildEnd and served by the dev middleware

Verification.Command: cd site && npm run build && npm run check

T-003.Title: Integration + count: shared head/consent/analytics, nav "Diagrams", sitemap, landing + README links; reconcile the type count across README/CHANGELOG/What's New/landing

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: R-4, R-5; landing edits additive and merged after C-57.

T-004.Title: GRACE: M-053 graph + V-M-053 verification, check-dist extension, evidence

T-001.Note: site/gallery/examples.mjs kept verbatim from the approved prototype (32 examples, one story). site/scripts/gallery-theme-vars.mjs parses every src/renderer/src/assets/themes/*.theme.css with util/theme.js's variable-mirror regex into the readActiveThemeTokens token shape (same variable names, literal parsing, Paper/Ink fallbacks, mirrored dark lists from config.js) and runs the app's own buildPeleVariables; site/gallery/theme-vars.json (16 --pele-* colour keys + page + dark per theme) is refreshed by every site build (buildEnd) and by npm run gallery:vars (needs node --experimental-default-type=module because src/muya/package.json has no type field; the vitepress build and vitest paths load it through vite/esbuild natively). tests/site/gallery-theme-vars.test.mjs: table follows the theme directory (32), every entry has exactly the 16 keys, committed file equals a fresh derivation, Paper/Ink and every theme shared with prototype/theme-vars.runtime-snapshot-2026-10-18.json match it exactly; site pins pele exactly 1.6.0 (root resolves 1.6.x). tests/site/gallery.test.mjs renders all 32 examples with pele DOM-free, error-free (corner-6).

T-002.Note: site/scripts/build-gallery.mjs reproduces the approved prototype (cards, wide rule, filter chips with counts, theme strip with swatches, Slideshow 1.5 s with Pause/any-chip stop, Fullscreen show 1.5 s per slide with theme-per-slide, counter, progress bar, Space/arrows/Esc, ends on the last slide and respects the active filter; default Paper/Ink by prefers-color-scheme, last choice remembered in localStorage) with two deliberate adaptations: the page chrome wears the site brand from site/landing/index.html (Schibsted Grotesk + JetBrains Mono self-hosted under %BASE%fonts, the oklch palette, brand-cyan accents; the prototype's Google-Fonts Bricolage/IBM Plex are NOT used) and the head is the shared site head via the new landing.mjs sharedHeadTags/renderPage (canonical + OG for /diagrams/, analytics/consent identical to the landing). Emitted at dist/diagrams/index.html by config.mts buildEnd (also refreshes theme-vars.json) and served by the dev middleware at /diagrams/ (corners 1-4 in the controller: Ink default + dark chrome under OS dark, chip/Esc stop timers, filtered fullscreen counter, one column under 760 px with safe-area padding and in-strip horizontal scroll).

T-003.Note: Shared head/consent/analytics already landed in T-002 (renderPage). T-003 adds the links and the count: landing header nav «Diagrams», the Diagrams showcase caption («32 diagram types in Mermaid syntax and Vega charts … See every type in the gallery») and the footer «Diagram gallery»; the sitemap lists diagrams/ via transformItems. Count reconciled to the gallery's 32 types and the 32 themes in theme-vars.json: landing «33 themes» → 32, README (the 2.3.1 «33 types» line left with the 2.3.1 section; new gallery links), CHANGELOG 2.4.0 «33 types» → 32 plus a 2.5.0 correction note; What's New 2.5.0 names the gallery in the also line. A docs nav entry was tried and dropped: it widened the phone nav bar past 390 px. Evidence: vitepress build + check-dist OK (svgs=32), sitemap contains https://mark.xronocode.com/diagrams/, the built landing carries the three links, tests/site 49/49.

T-004.Note: M-053 graph (new paths, fns, C-58 ref) and V-M-053 (tests/site command, scenario-7, BLOCK_CHECK_GALLERY/BLOCK_RENDER_PAGE/BLOCK_GALLERY_CARDS/BLOCK_DERIVE_THEME_VARS/BLOCK_WRITE_THEME_VARS markers) updated. check-dist.mjs v1.1.0 gates the gallery page: exists, one SVG per example, no PeleError, under 400 KB, external script/stylesheet hosts limited to the analytics providers the env actually configures (canonical/OG links are not loads). Known wiring gap for the orchestrator: root vitest.config.ts include does not cover tests/site yet, so npx vitest run tests/site needs the include entry (tests are DOM-free and pass under the default jsdom env with the shared setup, or under a dedicated node project without setupFiles).
